w: Reading A placed T3-149, reader B T3-149 and T3-119. r/straya's 'sorry about what happened, we'll try and help you get your beetle back', 'we apologize that we have taken a littlebit over. We shall help you protect your picture', 'our kangaroo project has taken a life of its own ... This is not authorised', 'make a plan for a redrawing/moving of your roach upwards a bit that we can help make', 'I totally reversed some of your progress ... Will work with you on this from now', 'let us know how we can help with re-drawing your roach', 'working on both the Kanga and the worm' and 'We will protect the roach!' are the attackers admitting the damage and helping rebuild (T3-119, reader B), eight concepts, and lead. 'striking back's not a good way to go', the agreement with r/Australia, 'a peace treaty in an orange banner', 'Fair do's if we leave Read worm and the beetle?', 'the amicable solution', 'It was never our intention to invade upon your bug' and 'we got a good truce going' end the fight (T3-149, all three placements), seven. Help returned for help, the alliance's conduct and the croc are left out. Content named: 'Cheers cunts', 'Cunt's Code of Honour'.

Reading A placed T3-149 and T3-056, reader B T3-149. 'On devrait essayer de faire la paix avec eux' (we should try to make peace with them), 'Si /r/canada nous laisse tranquille on devrait pas les déranger non plus' (if r/canada leaves us alone we should not bother them) and 'La plupart des gens en /r/canada ne veules pas vous combattre!' (most of r/canada do not want to fight you) seek peace (T3-149, all three placements). r/Canada's proposal for a Canada-Quebec design, the 'Proposition de design Canada-Québec' and the 'Proposition equitable de r/Canada' propose a joint mark (T3-056, reading A and my B1); the two tie at three concepts and T3-149 comes first on placements. The red square in 'Oh canada', the separation, the proxy-war suspicion and the deception in English are left out.

Reading A placed T3-149 and T3-011, reader B T3-149 with a bag. Zlatan's presence that 'brought parley', 'We have a truce with CFB which people keep breaking', 'there's a truce in place', 'Make a post quick about the truce', 'Ceasefire with r/liverpoolfc guys', Chelsea's 'not attack ours', 'I thought we had an agreement with cfb', 'Truce was broken', the thanks 'to the lads who agreed to the truce' and 'no reason for a truce' make, keep and break truces (T3-149, all three placements), ten concepts, and lead. 'we've been helping each other out all day', 'perhaps we should help them?' and 'Of course!' send help to r/CFB's work (T3-011, reading A), three. With two placed themes the item is not a bag; the apology for the script, the underlap compromise and the stopped griefing are left out.

Both readers placed T3-149 and T3-151. 'I'd appreciate it if I could keep the space', 'The green unturned logo? That sounds good to me', 'switch over to the old osu! space', r/neu's 'we appreciate the agreement that we have come up with' and 'see if they'll let us build' settle space with neighbours (T3-010, my B1), five concepts, and lead. White Space's help 'if we do not infringe on UF', 'Let us know if we can help you build something in another place' and 'I'll run yours for a bit' give help in return (T3-151, both readers), three. 'I don't suppose we could come to some sort of truce?' and 'I've made peace with literally everyone else here but you' seek peace (T3-149, both readers), alone at their level. The ruling keeps my B1's T3-010 beside the readers' list.

Reading A placed T3-149, reader B T3-149 and T3-150. 'We need co-ordination and Non-Aggression Pacts', 'If we stop fighting each other', 'If we only play defensively, we'll do the least to sabotage each other', 'Our warring days should be over' and 'don't attack each other' stop the schools' fighting (T3-149, all three placements), five concepts, and lead. 'I propose an alliance between /r/Argentina and your logo on /r/place against the eyes of Chavez' and 'We would LOVE to kick them out' form an alliance for a fight (T3-150, reader B and my B1), alone at their level. The messaging and the room approved for Maryland are left out. Content named: 'the eyes of Chavez'.

Reading A placed T3-149 and T3-010, reader B T3-149. The threat 'Se dovesse continuare l'aggressione', 'facciamo un NAP con loro', r/thefarleftside's compromise, 'entrambi i sub rispettino l'accordo', 'let's have peace between France and Italy', 'IL COMPROMESSO È FALLITO SIAMO IN GUERRA', the solution 'to the current conflict', the rejection of a unilateral offer, 'lasciamolo libero per la pace', 'A treaty would be nice', 'Ho proposto una tregua ai comunisti', 'we want to go into a new pact', 'Negoziamo la pace subito', the mods' resolution, 'un accordo per finirla con la guerra dei pixel' and 'Enough with the tiny flag war' end or forestall fights (T3-149, all three placements), sixteen concepts, and lead. The German and French agreements for the European-flag plan, the M on the green part 'a patto che', 'Non avevamo deciso di lasciarlo stare?', 'Lasciamogli un po' di spazio', warning Rainbow Road, the space under the Europe flag and the French painter in the red settle space with no fight named (T3-010, reading A), seven. The NATO idea, the love message, the repair offers and the halted logo are left out.

Reading A placed T3-149 with a bag, reader B T3-149 and T3-195. 'we socialists promise to not overrun your flag', 'please dont overrun palestine', 'Proposed treaty', 'Negotiations', 'we shouldn't do or say anything to ingite it again', 'Peace treaty: What do you guys think?', 'Just help us keep the peace please', 'Won't go into ur territory if u leave us be', 'We don't want to start a fight please' and the call to communicate and negotiate end or forestall the fight (T3-149, all three placements), ten concepts, and lead. 'followers didn't read agreements, mb we should duplicate them again', 'we have a peace treaty with Palestine. Do not incite this again', 'no one agreed on this' and 'It was agreed upon with /r/palestine on discord' hold the room to the agreement already made (T3-195, reader B), four. With two placed themes the item is not a bag; the offered space and the friendship heart are left out.

Reading A placed T3-149 and T3-010, reader B T3-149, T3-025 and T3-151. 'If there's another space we can agree on', 'an orange border next to ours', 'stop placing orange on the /r/aggies logo', the border planned once territorial issues were solved, help with the border, 'move the aggies border one square to the right?', 'happy to work together on a solution' and 'move the entire A&M up one' settle lines and space (T3-010, reading A), eight concepts, and lead. 'Aggies would actually help if you would stop putting orange all over ours', 'If y'all tell that one person ... to stop then we'll help you out', 'mutual support', and help that stops 'when you do vandalize ours' (four times) give help on condition (T3-151, reader B and my B1), seven. A UT version 'right next to' the ATM logo, the half-purple half-orange T, TEXAS spelled above A&M (twice), the half-violet half-orange sign, 'more collaboration and friendship between two rivals' and 'we're making your logo right next to ours' keep the rivals' marks side by side (T3-025, reader B), seven; T3-151 comes first on placements. That fills the limit of three: 'we ought to have a truce', 'I will not be the one to break the peace' and the mods' peace (T3-149, both readers, three concepts) rank fourth and are not kept.

Reading A placed T3-150 with a bag, reader B T3-149 with a bag. 'Someone needs to ask them to spare us. EDIT: Done.', 'we have a truce with the Fins at the moment', 'We have a truce with the Vikings. Would have one with yours as well', 'we're cool with finland now i think we gotta worry about the void', 'the void threatens us both so lets save this talk for later', 'Lets work with them to keep the C' and 'perhaps we can come to a compromise' make and keep truces (T3-149, reader B and my B1), seven concepts, and lead. 'Looks like Chicago has to collaborate', the ask that Chicago teams join, 'unite our efforts (along with Vikings and Lions subs maybe) to attack the Packers logo' and 'get all the Chicago subs on the same page' propose alliances for a fight (T3-150, reading A), four. With two placed themes the item is not a bag; betrayal, repair, help and taunts are left out. Content named: 'Finland is cancer', 'fuck the Finns'.

Reading A placed T3-149 and T3-151, reader B T3-151 and T3-149. 'a truce with /r/drugs has been achieved', 'peace treaty?', the compromise reached in r/drugs' Discord over the contested pixels, 'we won't damage the green lattice' and r/RPI's 'We request peace' make peace (T3-149, all three placements). The treaty with r/lost ('They agreed to do the same'), 'If we have a spare turn and see you guys are vandalized we'll help fix it', 'Help us help you!', r/landry's 'If you help us in any way, we will vow to help keep your logo preserved!' and 'The more we help, the more help we get!' trade help (T3-151, all three placements); the two tie at five concepts and three placements each. The alliance offer and the help request from r/Predators are left out.

Reading A placed T3-149, reader B T3-195 and T3-149. The DMZ and 'Neutrality agreement', 'You leave us alone, and we'll leave you guys alone', the negotiations in which 'they have agreed to stop attacking', 'do not instigate the Brazilians while we work on finalizing this neutrality pact', 'we finish the border and the deal is settled' and the Brazilian representative's permission make the non-aggression pact (T3-149, all three placements), six concepts, and lead. 'You guys start'd fucking up our flag without even talking to us', 'there are more Brazilians messing with your flag than people from this sub', 'We're struggling just to keep our space clean', 'we don't have anyone placing blocks on your flag' and 'Brazil...?' trace who is damaging which work (T3-087, my B1), five. 'there's more yellow in our sector again', 'remind people to not mess with our space', 'it's clearly stated Brazil is now allied to Hentai' and 'Their group has agreed to not mess with our space but ...' hold the rooms to the pact already made (T3-195, reader B and my B1), four.

Reading A placed T3-150 with a bag, reader B T3-150, T3-149 and T3-010. 'WE MUST HAVE A TEMPORARY TRUCE!!!!', its support, 'I promise to not cover any but blue', 'Neither side will directly attack each others blobs until those blobs touch', 'Both sides will do their best to leave creative art alone', the pact refused in the Void Discord and 'maintain peace for all colours' seek or refuse peace (T3-149, reader B), seven concepts, and lead. Purple's alliance request, the United Red Front, the existing cross-colour alliances and NAP, the Galaga alliance, 'We've worked out an alliance with Sweddit' and 'stay into our alliance' form alliances (T3-150, all three placements), six. 'move our thing down', 'please just don't overlap us', 'it's not the worst thing in the world if you guys build over us' and 'we've already been forced to move a ton' settle space (T3-010, reader B), four. With three placed themes the item is not a bag.

Both readers placed T3-150 with a bag. 'We must settle our differences and take down the Blue Union', NoColoreds' 'We stand with you in this fight', 'WE MUST UNITE, WE CAN STOP BLUE', 'shall we ally with r/ainbowroad?', the doubt whether allies fit the movement, 'natural allies', the alliance against the Dark Hole, the Monochrome Alliance (twice), the alliance with r/FightTheVoid, the alliance 'under ... Black', 'If you all joined forces with them' and 'unite in your erasing powers against the Void' form and weigh alliances for a fight (T3-150, both readers), thirteen concepts, and lead. 'Please let our Blue Corner brethen pass through, the Blue Highway needs to stand!' asks for passage through the erasers' ground (T3-010, my B1), alone at its level. The Rainbow Grid's request to cease 'the erasure of the ETP/Grid border' names an attack and is left out, as are attack calls, help requests, pleas and treaties invoked; with two placed themes the item is not a bag. Content named: 'the white fires of Alba Triangulum'.

Reading A placed T3-150 with a bag, reader B T3-150 and T3-149. 'I come to you with an offering of peace', 'We have to work with them, not against!', 'A message of peace' and 'Let's keep our flags intact!' offer peace (T3-149, reader B and my B1), four concepts, and lead. 'This is a call to cooperation! From r/Argentina!', 'Let's be brother in arms ... We'll aid you against the spiral of death' and 'Mutual Cooperation from /r/brasil' propose alliances for a fight (T3-150, all three placements), three. 'Thanks for the support mates, now we take on the void' thanks an ally (T3-072, my B1), alone at its level. The SquareSpiral proposal, formula1's maintenance and the mutual cleaning are left out.

Reading A placed T3-150 and T3-151, reader B T3-150. 'I propose an alliance to hold the eventual line', 'unite against the common enemy, blue', the short-range Red-Green alliance, 'they would make very good allies', 'We must protect our allies at all costs!', the three-corner alliance, 'help us on the battlefield in the upcoming war', the friendship with the Carrot Farm, 'We need some alliances', 'unify with the red corner to combat blue' and 'tackle the blue menace first' form alliances for a fight (T3-150, all three placements), eleven concepts, and lead. 'If you help protect us from the block M near us we will help expand the GreenCorner' and 'in exchange, they'll later help us purify ours' trade help (T3-151, reading A and my B1), alone at their level. My B1's T3-011 has no concept: protecting allies sits in the alliance frame. Purple's call, the orange corner and the false-flag warning are left out.

Both readers placed T3-150. 'We must join together and put a stop to the BLUE HIVEMIND!' invites kindred rooms to a front against an enemy (T3-150, 'rooms joining a front'). My B1's T3-013 (a hub gathering kindred rooms) and T3-062 (calls for hands to other subs) have no concept: no hub is founded and no hands are asked for the room's own work. The private sub and the pointer to r/GreenLattice are left out. The ruling is the readers' list.

Reading A placed T3-150, T3-011 and T3-084, reader B T3-150 and T3-011. 'r/india Alliance', 'teaming up with r/bindingofisaac', 'should we perhaps make an alliance?', 'Our alliance with India has proved useful', the alliance proposed to the Void, the reserved sections 'built from alliances and treaties' and 'Call in the fandoms and nations' form alliances (T3-150, all three placements), seven concepts, and lead. 'we're helping India beat back the void now', 'India will not fall', 'only fair to help repair their flag', '/r/India is under attack!' and 'Help ss13's logo against the void' send help to other rooms' work (T3-011, both readers), five. Armenia's request relayed, r/unturned's 'we need all help possible' and 'mind helping us?', and 'I'm requesting assistance from those that are listed as allies' ask other rooms for help (T3-084, reading A), four. The collaborations with Starbound and Undertale and the thanks are left out.

Both readers placed T3-150. 'we have your back over at r/thefarleftside ... Keep up the good fight, comrades!', 'Our comrades at r/TheFarLeftSide/ need our help in pushing back the fascist scourges ... Heed the workers' call', 'I have joined the team, primarily to protect the sickle' and 'work together with the others at TheFarLeftSide' join a front (T3-150, both readers), four concepts, and lead. 'We have made a YPG flag and a Rojava flag, and we are currently under attack by Italian fascists, so come and help us defend the barricades!' and 'We at /r/TheFarLeftSide ... you can join us to help protect the flag' carry a call for hands into this community (T3-062, my B1; its decide_when_both sends 'a call for hands posted to a community' there), alone at their level. The offers to help, 'rely on the Russians again' and the greetings are left out. Content named: 'the fascist scourges', 'Italian fascists', the YPG and Rojava flags, the sickle.

Reading A placed T3-150, reader B T3-150 and T3-011. 'Ill help out whenever i can', 'From /r/OnePiece will be glad to help!', 'I'm happy to help you guys', 'I can try help def your too', Funhaus helping with the new layout, 'I'm helping all I can to save our neighbor!', roosterteeth 'helping as much as I can', Funhaus 'will assist in defending', OnePiece 'doing what I can' and 'i tried to help fix it' send help to another room's work (T3-011, reader B), ten concepts, and lead. 'we need a layering alliance', 'Pirate-Ninja alliance wins!', Funhaus's 'I'll protect your orange, and I hope you'll protect ours' and its acceptance, the list of ALLIANCES, 'I'll look out for ya'll as well', 'The Pirate-Ninja alliance!', the vow 'to form an alliance' and 'Funhaus and Naruto should stick together' form alliances with mutual protection (T3-150, all three placements), nine. The art guide, the blame for the griefing and the thanks are left out.

Reading A placed T3-150, reader B T3-150 and T3-149. 'Peace treaty: Let's do this!', 'They don't touch us we don't touch them. We can't be the aggressors', the 'Street Artists' Code', 'We assure you that we do not plan to invade', 'could you pls do not invade our green?' and 'We won't' make peace and non-aggression (T3-149, reader B and my B1), six concepts, and lead. The 'Ukrainian-Palestinian Alliance', 'We will try to defend ours and yours flag', 'let's agree to defend each other's hearts?', 'Agreed' and the Israeli flag Discord's offer to 'help each other and repel attacks' form alliances with mutual defence (T3-150, all three placements), five. My B1's T3-194 has no concept: the greetings from Ukraine and the hello from r/Jordan name no envoy or errand. The list of treaties and the message from r/theitalyplace are left out.

Reading A placed T3-150, T3-010 and T3-072, reader B T3-150 and T3-010. '4chan is a big help', 'Poland was a massive help last night. Can't thank those guys enough', 'Are crusaders helping us? Heck yeah!' and 'thanks to T_D wrecking their flag for a few hours to distract them' thank the rooms that stood with the room (T3-072, reading A and my B1), four concepts, and lead. 'We're now in good alliances with most of our neighbors', 'We are in alliance with Poland' and 'Join the Alliance today! Snek, Poland, AMD, FRC, and now Crusaders' form alliances (T3-150, both readers), three. The spot 'Below the American flag and above the Polish flag' and the black border 'so the US flag can go around nicely' settle space (T3-010, all three placements), and lead their level on placements over my B1's T3-024 ('Best to keep the rainbow', 'avoid conflict'), which is not kept. Content named: 'that big font CCCP will get turned into FEELS GOOD', T_D.

Reading A placed T3-150, T3-194 and T3-083, reader B T3-150 and T3-083. 'I hope there isn't too much of a language barrier with the Spanish Portuguese/English', 'we don't speak spanish. We speak portuguese', the apology for 'like 5 years of Spanish courses', the mock 'Transláção', 'tons of people do that!' and 'call them and ask for forgiveness' make language the problem in dealing with the allied room (T3-083, both readers), six concepts, and lead. 'agora encontramo-nos incluidos na Flag Alliance' and the request for groups 'beneficial aliar-nos' join and seek alliances (T3-150, all three placements), alone at their level. 'Voltei de missão diplomática!' (back from a diplomatic mission) is an envoy's errand (T3-194, reading A and my B1), alone at its level. 'PROTEJAM A BANDEIRA!!!' and the spelling joke are left out.

Both readers placed T3-150, reader B with a bag. 'We're helping Elite and they are helping us', 'joining with our Elite brothers', the logos combined in one script, KSP's 'Defense pact: mutual defense plan', 'joined our brothers in spaceships', 'cross support our bretheren', 'space sim kids are sticking together', 'combine our powers. SC and ED together lets defend', 'KSP/SC/ED space alliance', the cooperation against the void (twice), 'They helped us build now we need to take part in defending' and 'SC and ED together' form an alliance for building and defence (T3-150, both readers), thirteen concepts, and lead. 'keep the KSP text to the left of us intact', Elite's 'put your logo to the left of ours', 'make your border skip over the P from KSP', 'work around r/KSP', 'We need the room', the Danish border taken down, 'we will figure out a way to accommodate them', space for FTL and rainbowroad's approval for a Hornet settle lines and space with neighbours (T3-010, my B1), nine. With two placed themes the item is not a bag; defence calls, help, envoys, thanks and celebrations are left out.

Reading A placed T3-150 with a bag, reader B T3-150 and T3-010, my B1 T3-138. The border proposal sent to r/de, 'Let them know that we're a sovereign territory' (twice), 'a deal with him now to avoid edit-warring', r/yuyuyu's right to write 'in our beautiful blue skies' and the pact behind it, and 'we wont go over it' settle lines and space (T3-010, reader B), seven concepts, and lead; help given for room counts toward T3-010 for the space it settles, since no placement holds T3-151. 'I will try to make an alliance', 'An Alliance offer has arrived', 'Alliance with r/ainbowroad?', 'Switzerland and Mona Lisa unite!' and 'Help our allies in case of a massive attack' (twice) form alliances for defence (T3-150, both readers), six. 'MONA LISA ACCEPT OUR NEUTRALITY', 'How neutral', 'Helping America ... is the most swiss thing to do' and 'If you want to be truly neutral you couldn't even help the Mona Lisa' argue the room's neutrality (T3-138, my B1), four. With three placed themes the item is not a bag.

'Let us unite to fight against the blues and reds!', 'Join us at the Lattice fellow greens!!!', 'should we try to start a joint effort to take out the blues?' and 'We politely invite you to join our cause' form an alliance for a fight (T3-150, all three placements), four concepts, and lead.
